title: Existing materials / review library
summary: Twelve selected base color previews from the existing local material library, plus one native export check. These are source samples, not proposed new textures or an approved palette. Click any image for the full review copy and download.

items.title: Designer / verified export sample
items.alt: 256 by 256 base color output produced by the installed Adobe cooker and renderer
items.body: **Tool verification, not a new material.** `Brutalist_Concrete_01.sbs` was cooked and rendered at 256 × 256 into a scratch folder using Designer 15.0.1. Base color, normal and ORM outputs were produced. Original source and game texture exports were not overwritten. Interactive graph edits remain unverified.

items.title: LaCarlota / existing material variants
items.alt: Owner-supplied Unreal material board with labeled surface families
items.body:
**Owner-supplied native board from Temp.** Existing variants are organized under `/Game/Art/MI/Utility_Materials`, alongside vertex-paint blends under `/Game/Art/MI/Vertex_Paint_Blend`. Use the library before authoring another material.

The current registry contains 88 distinct material-instance assets under Utility_Materials. This is an asset inventory, not a count of finished surfaces or a runtime budget.

items.title: Corrected / CobbleStone_02 packed data
items.body:
**Saved in pass 01.** `/Game/Art/MI/Utility_Materials/Concrete/CobbleStone_02/CobbleStone_02_occlusionRoughnessMetallic`: sRGB **off**, compression **Masks**. Previously sRGB on with default color compression.

R = AO; G = roughness; B = metallic. Traced material/Blueprint references reach only Basement and LaCarlota. The texture is shared by the cobblestone preview and two painted blends; those material assets were not overwritten.

items.title: Confirmed / intentional floor and ceiling UV exceptions
items.body:
The sampled wall UVs use about 0.5 UV units/m: 512 px × 0.5 ≈ **256 px/m**. The floor UVs use about 0.24975 units/m with a current 512 px concrete and 1× material tiling: approximately **128 px/m**.

**Owner clarification, 12 November 2026.** Some modular floors and ceilings intentionally depart from 256/512 px/m to match their specific tileable texture. Preserve their UV scale and material tiling. This floor is an accepted exception, not a pending density correction.
